summary: Completed frontend testing for NF Detail Modal and NF Links features (Iteration 16). All 6 features PASSED. The NF detail modal opens correctly when clicking on NF numbers in Documents page, showing items with all tax columns, CFOP totals, and integrity indicators (green for OK, red for divergence). NF links in Validação & IA page are clickable and navigate to Documents page.

Feature 3: Modal mostra totalizador por CFOP com soma de valores - PASSED (shows CFOP breakdown with Qtd, Valor, BC ICMS, ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS)

Feature 4: Modal mostra indicador de integridade vermelho (Com Divergência) - PASSED (NF 30073 shows red indicator with difference details)
Feature 5: Página Validação & IA mostra números das NFs como links clicáveis - PASSED (NF numbers shown in blue as clickable links)
Feature 6: Links das NFs navegam para página de Documentos - PASSED (clicking NF 118010 navigated to /documents?highlight=...)
